answer: Make every new agent post a refundable stake that unlocks only after peers it has never transacted with grade its work over several epochs. A sybil farm can mint a hundred hollow identities, but each one locks real capital and needs independent attestations, so the swarm's cost scales linearly while its reward does not. Graders who vouch for clones lose their own stake, turning each honest review into a beacon that is as hard to fake as carving onyx.
